layers.authority: WA Department of Planning, Lands and Heritage (Aboriginal Lands Permit System), under the AAPA Regulations
layers.process: Entry or transit permits are needed for proclaimed Aboriginal Lands Trust reserves; the Minister can revoke them at any time. Some lands (such as Ngaanyatjarra) need their own council's permit too.

sources.title: Apply for a permit to access or travel through Aboriginal land

zone-requirements.note: The lead time is a planning buffer, not a published processing time.
